title: An update on my Diablo-style hamster ARPG: skill combos and runes
author: Tap_Little
selftext:
I shared the HAMSTER: CLAW trailer here recently. Here's a look at the skill combos and runes I've been working on.



Combos reward the order you use skills in, like freezing enemies before a shatter attack. Runes mix another element into a weapon's skills.



I'm using Codex Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 for the code in Godot, then playtesting the results and asking for changes.



Do the effects look too busy, or is it still easy to follow the action?



Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363820/HAMSTER\_CLAW/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363820/HAMSTER_CLAW/)

comments.author: Tap_Little
comments.body:
For anyone curious about the numbers, there are currently 228 equipment items, including 74 weapons, and 204 weapon skills. There are also 12 rune types across 4 rarity tiers (48 variants), and weapons can have up to 3 rune sockets.



These systems are already working in-game, so you can experiment with different skills, runes and elemental combos.
